title: ExportPdf Command
description: Write a vector PDF of Forsk Layout pages to an absolute .pdf path. No save dialog.

layout.description: Optional page name (Forsk — Plan) or view token (plan, north, east, south, west, schedules). Omit to export every Forsk layout.

set.description: Which set: sheets (default) or analysis, the Analysis set's own sheets (A-80-00n: daylight per room, areas). Its pages print as their own PDF; the Sheets set never includes them.
